A natural sweet, brimming with nutrition and made by stewing fresh honey|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Energizing Honey Candies are made by [[Cooking]] at least one [[Courser Bee Honey]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Since they are composed entirely of Courser Bee Honey, there is no default version of Honey Candies, as all results grant the energizing effect. Honey Candies can be sold for 20 to 140 [[Rupee]]s, depending on how many Courser Bee Honeys were used. When eaten, Energizing Honey Candies will instantly refill a portion of [[Link]]'s [[Stamina Wheel]], as well as replenish two to 18 [[Heart]]s in his [[Life Gauge]]. ====Recipes==== {|class="wikitable" !Materials Used !Effect !Hearts !Sell Price |- |[[Courser Bee Honey]] x1 |1/3 [[Stamina Restoration]] |2 |20 [[Rupee]]s |- |Courser Bee Honey x2 |1 Stamina Restoration |6 |40 Rupees |- |Courser Bee Honey x3 |1 2/3 Stamina Restoration |10 |70 Rupees |- |Courser Bee Honey x4 |2 1/5 Stamina Restoration |14 |100 Rupees |- |Courser Bee Honey x5 |2 3/4 Stamina Restoration |18 |140 Rupees |} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The Recipe for Honey Candy is obtained by completing the [[Scenario]] "[[The Road Home, Besieged]]". It is made using two [[Courser Bee Honey]]s. Through the completion of the [[Quest]] "[[Hungry Hunches]]", however, it can be reduced to one. [[Cooking]] Honey Candy before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]] increases the amount of [[Rupee]]s gained by the [[Warrior]]s by twenty percent. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Honey Candy Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Energizing Honey Candy icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
